desc: Implement the solution in Python: precompute modular inverses for 1..N+1 using linear method.
Read A[2..N] and compute prefix sums pre1 (for A_i * 2(i-1)/(i(i+1))) and pre2 (for A_i / i) modulo MOD.
For each query (u,v), compute answer: if u==1, ans = fact * (pre2[v-1] + A_v) % MOD; else, ans = fact * (pre1[u] + (pre2[v-1]-pre2[u] if v-1>u else 0) + A_v) % MOD, ensuring positive mod.
Test on provided samples to verify correctness.
